prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Learn Desktop Controls", "Mastering Your Desktop Pet", "Learn quick mouse gestures and keyboard shortcuts to interact with your pet anytime.", "Right-click pet for control options menu", "Finish Setup"]
1: ["Welcome Your New Companion", "Give your official adoption certificate a personalized pet name before finalizing.", "Enter Pet Name"]
2: ["Is your pet visible on your screen?", "Confirm that your pet has landed safely on your taskbar or desktop edge.", "Yes, I see my pet!", "Troubleshoot Display"]
3: ["Synthesizing Your Custom Pet", "We are generating 3D animations and behavioral scripts for your companion.", "Rendering pet assets...", "Estimated completion: 2 mins"]
4: ["Sign in with your original account to automatically restore existing pets and avoid account resets."]
5: ["Upload front-facing, well-lit photos for the most accurate custom pet generation."]
6: ["Includes Starter Accessory Pack!"]
7: ["We will pop up a system alert on your desktop when your pet is ready!"]
8: ["Adopt Your Desktop Companion", "Create an interactive pet that wanders your screen, plays games, and keeps you company while you work."]
9: ["Release Pet to Desktop"]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal photos of the user
Mentions free extras or bonus packs
